summary_1line: Lomasa guides the Pandavas through sacred sites of ancient sacrifices near the Yamuna and Saraswati, where Yudhishthira bathes and briefly beholds all worlds.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ground around Yayati’s ancient altar is covered with countless fire pits as if the earth itself sinks beneath the weight of his sacrifices.
Yudhishthira rises from the sacred waters while sages chant, and in his vision he beholds all the worlds and Arjuna riding a white steed.
A solitary Sami tree with a single leaf stands beside quiet lakes of Parasurama near the ancient hermitage of Narayana.
